name: Generate Daily GWR Timetable

on:
  schedule:
    # This instructs GitHub to run the workflow automatically every night at 3:00 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # This allows you to click a manual "Run" button in GitHub to test it anytime

jobs:
  build-and-run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python Environment
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Install Network Dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run Core Timetable Engine
      run: |
        python cron_job.py

    - name: Commit and Push Updated Timetable JSON
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "GWR Timetable Bot"
        git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
        git add gwr_timetable_tomorrow.json gwr_timetable_tomorrow.csv
        git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "Automated Daily Timetable Update: $(date +'%Y-%m-%d')"
        git push
